title: ClawAI workflow file
description: A file in .clawai/workflows is either a user-defined workflow template (mirrors workflowTemplateSchema in src/core/workflow-template.ts) or a saved agent graph (mirrors savedWorkflowSchema in src/core/saved-workflow.ts). A template is told apart by "kind": "template"; a saved graph has no kind. Both are re-validated when read, so this schema is editor help, not the gate.

instruction.description: What the agent is asked to do when this workflow runs.

acceptanceChecks.description: Checks that must hold, with evidence, before the workflow is reported done.

requestPrompt.description: When set, the person starting the workflow is asked this question and the answer is added as the request.

graph.description: The agent graph passed to runtime.agents. Validated in full by the extension when the workflow is loaded.
